mapper.select: select sifg.inventory_flow_goods_id, sifg.goods_id, sifg.shop_id, sifg.goods_num, sifg.buy_num, si.put_storage_id, si.out_storage_id, mgb.goods_name, mgb.goods_spec from storage_inventory_flow_goods sifg left join ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_base mgb on mgb.goods_id = sifg.goods_id left join storage_inventory_flow si on si.inventory_flow_id = sifg.inventory_flow_id where sifg.inventory_flow_id = #{inventoryFlowId}
